speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, please tell me more about your progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Boxed Fracture of the Right Ring Finger.

Thank you for the history; the mechanism of injury (jersey pull) strongly suggests a fracture. Given the progressive swelling and pain, I need to confirm the bone integrity. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray Right Hand.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
